meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能从你提供的目录、网址、粘贴的笔记或刚刚的对话中，提炼出一个可复用的技能（SKILL.md 文件），或者用新知识改进已有技能。
howto.when: 当你说出 “/learn”、“learn this”、“turn this into a skill”、“capture this workflow”、“make a skill from <source>” 或 “improve/update the <name> skill” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: learn what we just did 把刚刚的操作流程存成技能
say.note: Claude 会回顾对话，提炼出可复用的步骤。

say.text: /learn /path/to/project 把这个目录相关的操作变成技能
say.note: Claude 会读取文件结构，构建一个技能。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can distill a reusable skill (SKILL.md file) from a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the current conversation, or refine an existing skill with new learnings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'.

say_en.text: /learn https://example.com/docs turn this URL into a skill
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the page and generate a skill file.

say_en.text: learn what we just did save this workflow as a skill
say_en.note: Claude will review the conversation and extract repeatable steps.

say_en.text: /learn /path/to/project build a skill from this directory
say_en.note: Claude will read the file structure and create a skill.
